 Advocate for : MR D K MISHRA  Advocate for : ASSTT.S.G.I. appearing for UNION OF INDIA AND ANR. 
 BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE KALYAN RAI SURANA  ORDER Date : 24.04.2024 Mr. R. K. Agarwal, learned counsel for the petitioner is present. He submits that in view of Section 35(k) of the IBC 2016 as well as in light of order dated 18.12.2023 passed by the NCLT, Guwahati bench in I.A. (I.B.C.)/3/GB/2023 in C.P.(I.B.)/18/GB/2021, he is under legal bar to appear for the petitioner in this case. The said submission is recorded. 
2. Mr. B. Chakravarty, learned CGC appearing for the respondent no.1 has submitted that he is in receipt of instruction dated 12.01.2021 by the Under Secretary to the Govt. of India, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Department of Health & Family Welfare (Food Regulation Section), that the order impugned in this writ petition has been withdrawn in view of the orders passed by the High Court of Delhi in WP(C) 8834/2020 and other connected matters.
3. The learned CGC has provided photocopies thereof to be retained in record.
Page No.# 3/3 4. In view of the submissions is made by the learned CGC, the matter has become infructuous. 
5. Accordingly, this matter stands closed having been rendered infructuous.
